# Requirement
```text
 Overall/Domain description.
 Console pipe-connection game: grid with outer walls, one source inside pointing inward, one sink on the border
  pointing outward. Player places pipes from a queue; after a delay, water flows along placed pipes.
Cell[][] uses 0-based array indices, but index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts at internal index 1: [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]. Player-facing coordinates are deliberately aligned with these playable indices: row 1 maps to internal row 1, column 'A' maps to internal col 1. No row-1/col-1 conversion is performed.
 Direction provides four directions plus opposite/offset; PipeShape defines
  connection
  directions; TerminationType distinguishes SOURCE vs SINK.

  Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction: Coordinate.row and Coordinate.col represent internal Cell[][] array indices and are used directly as cells[row][col]. A Cell stored at cells[r][c] should have Coordinate(row=r, col=c). 
Because the outer wall border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally start at index 1, so player input aligns with internal playable indices.
  Direction enum provides four directions (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) and Pa19Helper provides getOpposite() returning the opposite direction
  and getOffset() returning the unit coordinate offset for movement calculations.

  Game: Operations to place a pipe, skip, undo, advance water flow, check win, check loss; convenience fromString
  constructor; maintain step count. 
Operation placePipe: This method maps the player column letter to an internal column index using col - 'A' + 1, 
keeps row unchanged, and places the pipe at cells[row][colIndex]. For example, placePipe(1, 'A') targets cells[1][1].
Operation skipPipe: Consumes the current pipe from the queue and increments the step count. Operation
  undoStep: Pops the last placed cell from CellStack, restores the pipe to the queue head, clears the cell on the map,
  and increments the step count. Returns false if there are no steps to undo.

  Map: Cells are stored as a 2D array Cell[][] with indices [0..rows-1] × [0..cols-1],
  where index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are walls (border). The playable area occupies
  internal indices [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], which aligns with 1-based
  user input mapping. tryPlacePipe(row, col, pipe) accepts playable-area aligned coordinates (row and col in [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]) and uses them
  directly as array indices (no conversion needed due to the wall alignment).
  It rejects: (1) row/col outside [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], (2) non-FillableCell,
  or (3) already-occupied cell.

  Cell family: Cell.fromChar parses map chars to concrete cells; FillableCell holds an optional pipe and renders pipe or
  '.'; TerminationCell holds pointingTo direction and Type (SOURCE/SINK), with filled state for rendering; Wall renders
  wall char.

  TerminationCell.toSingleChar: Returns the corresponding arrow character based on the current termination cell's
  filling state and pointingTo direction: when filled, returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Filled; when unfilled,
  returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Unfilled. Both SOURCE and SINK use pointingTo directly without direction reversal.
  Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

  Pipe: Expose connection directions via getConnections() returning Direction[] based on Shape; char rendering by
  filled/unfilled state; construct from short string code (HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, CR). getConnections(): Returns the
  list of connection directions based on the current pipe shape; throws IllegalStateException("Unknown shape") if the
  shape is not recognized. toSingleChar(): Returns the character representation of this pipe, different for filled and
  unfilled pipes.

  Water Flow: fillBeginTile() marks the source cell as filled. fillTiles(distance) fills pipes within the specified
  distance from source using BFS-style expansion. Water propagates along pipes only when adjacent pipes have matching
  connection directions (one pipe's direction must be the opposite of the other). Each round increments the fill
  distance by 1.

  Win/Loss Conditions: checkPath() uses BFS to determine if a connected path exists from SOURCE to SINK by following
  (i) from SOURCE, step once in the SOURCE pointingTo direction, and (ii) from a pipe cell, step in each pipe connection direction.
  It does not require the traversed pipes to be filled; reaching the SINK cell implies win. hasLost() returns true when prevFilledTiles == 0,
  meaning no new pipes were filled in the previous round (loss condition). The game checks loss only after delay has ended (distance > 0).

  PipeQueue: peek/consume/undo head pipe and auto-refill to fixed length with random shapes. undo(Pipe) inserts the pipe
  back to the front of the queue.

  DelayBar: countdown() decrements the current value by 1 each round. distance() returns -currentValue, representing how
  far the water should flow (negative during countdown, positive after delay ends).

  CellStack: push/pop last placement; undoCount counts the number of successful undo actions (i.e., successful pop
  operations), not the current stack size; 

  External/Tool Classes (not generated; handwritten or reused,You only need to assume that these Java files mentioned below are already in the pa19 package.)
  Pa19Helper is a small helper/assembly class used to build core game model objects for this project. It provides
  convenience methods to (1) construct a Game by wiring together Map, PipeQueue, DelayBar, and CellStack from given
  inputs, and (2) create/parse basic elements (e.g., Map from a Cell[][] or string representation, map characters/short
  codes into Cell/Pipe). It also centralizes simple direction utilities (opposite direction and unit offsets) used
  during parsing and movement-related calculations.
  Deserializer: Purpose: deserialize map input into runtime objects. Field: Path path (input file path). Constructors:
  Deserializer(String path) delegates to private Deserializer(Path); private Deserializer(Path) validates file existence
  and throws FileNotFoundException if missing. Methods: Game parseGame() reads rows, cols, delay, map lines, and
  optional default pipes, then returns Pa19Helper.createGame(...); on unexpected EOF or I/O failure, returns null
  (and logs error). static Cell[][] parseString(int rows, int cols, String cellsRep) converts multiline text to a Cell
  matrix by character, using Pa19Helper.cellFromChar with SINK type on border cells and SOURCE type on inner
  cells. private String getFirstNonEmptyLine(BufferedReader br) returns the first non-blank, non-comment line (ignores
  lines starting with #), or null at end of stream.

  PipePatterns: Purpose: central constant repository for all map-rendering characters. Design: final utility class with
  private constructor (non-instantiable). Exposed constants: WALL (solid wall block), plus two nested static groups:
  Filled and Unfilled. Each group defines arrow chars (UP_ARROW, DOWN_ARROW, LEFT_ARROW, RIGHT_ARROW) and pipe-shape
  chars (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, CROSS). Use PipePatterns constants for
  all rendering chars; do not hardcode glyphs in TerminationCell and PipeShape logic.

  StringUtils: Purpose: provide lightweight string helper utilities. Class design: utility class with a private
  constructor to prevent instantiation. 
```

# Requirement
```text
 Overall/Domain description.
 Console pipe-connection game: grid with outer walls, one source inside pointing inward, one sink on the border
  pointing outward. Player places pipes from a queue; after a delay, water flows along placed pipes.
Cell[][] uses 0-based array indices, but index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts at internal index 1: [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]. Player-facing coordinates are deliberately aligned with these playable indices: row 1 maps to internal row 1, column 'A' maps to internal col 1. No row-1/col-1 conversion is performed.
 Direction provides four directions plus opposite/offset; PipeShape defines
  connection
  directions; TerminationType distinguishes SOURCE vs SINK.

  Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction: Coordinate.row and Coordinate.col represent internal Cell[][] array indices and are used directly as cells[row][col]. A Cell stored at cells[r][c] should have Coordinate(row=r, col=c). 
Because the outer wall border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally start at index 1, so player input aligns with internal playable indices.
  Direction enum provides four directions (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) and Pa19Helper provides getOpposite() returning the opposite direction
  and getOffset() returning the unit coordinate offset for movement calculations.

  Game: Operations to place a pipe, skip, undo, advance water flow, check win, check loss; convenience fromString
  constructor; maintain step count. 
Operation placePipe: This method maps the player column letter to an internal column index using col - 'A' + 1, 
keeps row unchanged, and places the pipe at cells[row][colIndex]. For example, placePipe(1, 'A') targets cells[1][1].
Operation skipPipe: Consumes the current pipe from the queue and increments the step count. Operation
  undoStep: Pops the last placed cell from CellStack, restores the pipe to the queue head, clears the cell on the map,
  and increments the step count. Returns false if there are no steps to undo.

  Map: Cells are stored as a 2D array Cell[][] with indices [0..rows-1] × [0..cols-1],
  where index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are walls (border). The playable area occupies
  internal indices [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], which aligns with 1-based
  user input mapping. tryPlacePipe(row, col, pipe) accepts playable-area aligned coordinates (row and col in [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]) and uses them
  directly as array indices (no conversion needed due to the wall alignment).
  It rejects: (1) row/col outside [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], (2) non-FillableCell,
  or (3) already-occupied cell.

  Cell family: Cell.fromChar parses map chars to concrete cells; FillableCell holds an optional pipe and renders pipe or
  '.'; TerminationCell holds pointingTo direction and Type (SOURCE/SINK), with filled state for rendering; Wall renders
  wall char.

  TerminationCell.toSingleChar: Returns the corresponding arrow character based on the current termination cell's
  filling state and pointingTo direction: when filled, returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Filled; when unfilled,
  returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Unfilled. Both SOURCE and SINK use pointingTo directly without direction reversal.
  Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

  Pipe: Expose connection directions via getConnections() returning Direction[] based on Shape; char rendering by
  filled/unfilled state; construct from short string code (HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, CR). getConnections(): Returns the
  list of connection directions based on the current pipe shape; throws IllegalStateException("Unknown shape") if the
  shape is not recognized. toSingleChar(): Returns the character representation of this pipe, different for filled and
  unfilled pipes.

  Water Flow: fillBeginTile() marks the source cell as filled. fillTiles(distance) fills pipes within the specified
  distance from source using BFS-style expansion. Water propagates along pipes only when adjacent pipes have matching
  connection directions (one pipe's direction must be the opposite of the other). Each round increments the fill
  distance by 1.

  Win/Loss Conditions: checkPath() uses BFS to determine if a connected path exists from SOURCE to SINK by following
  (i) from SOURCE, step once in the SOURCE pointingTo direction, and (ii) from a pipe cell, step in each pipe connection direction.
  It does not require the traversed pipes to be filled; reaching the SINK cell implies win. hasLost() returns true when prevFilledTiles == 0,
  meaning no new pipes were filled in the previous round (loss condition). The game checks loss only after delay has ended (distance > 0).

  PipeQueue: peek/consume/undo head pipe and auto-refill to fixed length with random shapes. undo(Pipe) inserts the pipe
  back to the front of the queue.

  DelayBar: countdown() decrements the current value by 1 each round. distance() returns -currentValue, representing how
  far the water should flow (negative during countdown, positive after delay ends).

  CellStack: push/pop last placement; undoCount counts the number of successful undo actions (i.e., successful pop
  operations), not the current stack size; 

  External/Tool Classes (not generated; handwritten or reused,You only need to assume that these Java files mentioned below are already in the pa19 package.)
  Pa19Helper is a small helper/assembly class used to build core game model objects for this project. It provides
  convenience methods to (1) construct a Game by wiring together Map, PipeQueue, DelayBar, and CellStack from given
  inputs, and (2) create/parse basic elements (e.g., Map from a Cell[][] or string representation, map characters/short
  codes into Cell/Pipe). It also centralizes simple direction utilities (opposite direction and unit offsets) used
  during parsing and movement-related calculations.
  Deserializer: Purpose: deserialize map input into runtime objects. Field: Path path (input file path). Constructors:
  Deserializer(String path) delegates to private Deserializer(Path); private Deserializer(Path) validates file existence
  and throws FileNotFoundException if missing. Methods: Game parseGame() reads rows, cols, delay, map lines, and
  optional default pipes, then returns Pa19Helper.createGame(...); on unexpected EOF or I/O failure, returns null
  (and logs error). static Cell[][] parseString(int rows, int cols, String cellsRep) converts multiline text to a Cell
  matrix by character, using Pa19Helper.cellFromChar with SINK type on border cells and SOURCE type on inner
  cells. private String getFirstNonEmptyLine(BufferedReader br) returns the first non-blank, non-comment line (ignores
  lines starting with #), or null at end of stream.

  PipePatterns: Purpose: central constant repository for all map-rendering characters. Design: final utility class with
  private constructor (non-instantiable). Exposed constants: WALL (solid wall block), plus two nested static groups:
  Filled and Unfilled. Each group defines arrow chars (UP_ARROW, DOWN_ARROW, LEFT_ARROW, RIGHT_ARROW) and pipe-shape
  chars (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, CROSS). Use PipePatterns constants for
  all rendering chars; do not hardcode glyphs in TerminationCell and PipeShape logic.

  StringUtils: Purpose: provide lightweight string helper utilities. Class design: utility class with a private
  constructor to prevent instantiation.
```

  1.4 Generate the class summarization.
2. A method is unimplemented if its body contains `// TODO: Please complete this Java method based on the docstring`.
3. For every unimplemented method, 
  3.1 You must read the docstring of this method. The fragment between `<!-- begin-model-doc -->` and `<!-- end-model-doc -->` contains the method specification;
  3.2 Generate your code strictly according to the algorithm; Be aware of the EMF code style and APIs;
  3.3 You should not change the method signature;
  3.4 After generation, replace the current body with the one you generate;
  3.5 Keep and update the docstring by changing `@generated` to `@generated NOT`.
4. Check the import list. Add missing imports if needed.
5. Do not change other part.
6. Be aware of the method signatures, particularly, the input and output types, provided in the **Context**.

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

```java
public boolean placePipe(final int row, final char col)
{
    // Convert column letter to internal index
    int colIndex = col - 'A' + 1;
    // Keep row unchanged (player row = internal row)
    // Peek the current pipe from the queue
    Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    // Call map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe)
    boolean success = map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe);
    if (success) {
        // Consume the pipe from queue
        pipeQueue.consume();
        // Push the cell to cellStack
        Cell cell = map.getCell()[row][colIndex];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) cell);
        }
        // Increment numOfSteps
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

```java
public boolean placePipe(final int row, final char col)
{
    // Convert column letter to internal index
    int colIndex = col - 'A' + 1;
    // Keep row unchanged (player row = internal row)
    // Peek the current pipe from the queue
    Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    // Call map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe)
    boolean success = map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe);
    if (success) {
        // Consume the pipe from queue
        pipeQueue.consume();
        // Push the cell to cellStack
        Cell cell = map.getCell()[row][colIndex];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) cell);
        }
        // Increment numOfSteps
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

```java
public boolean placePipe(final int row, final char col)
{
    // Convert column letter to internal index
    int colIndex = col - 'A' + 1;
    // Keep row unchanged (player row = internal row)
    // Peek the current pipe from the queue
    Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    // Call map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe)
    boolean success = map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe);
    if (success) {
        // Consume the pipe from queue
        pipeQueue.consume();
        // Push the cell to cellStack
        Cell cell = map.getCell()[row][colIndex];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) cell);
        }
        // Increment numOfSteps
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

  1.1 Navigate the Ecore model to find related classes
  1.2 Also consider the related classes in the Javadocs.
  1.3 Locate these files in your project.
  1.4 Generate the class summarization.
2. A method is unimplemented if its body contains `// TODO: Please complete this Java method based on the docstring`.
3. For every unimplemented method, 
  3.1 You must read the docstring of this method. The fragment between `<!-- begin-model-doc -->` and `<!-- end-model-doc -->` contains the method specification;
  3.2 Generate your code strictly according to the algorithm; Be aware of the EMF code style and APIs;
  3.3 You should not change the method signature;
  3.4 After generation, replace the current body with the one you generate;
  3.5 Keep and update the docstring by changing `@generated` to `@generated NOT`.
4. Check the import list. Add missing imports if needed.
5. Do not change other part.
6. Be aware of the method signatures, particularly, the input and output types, provided in the **Context**.

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    // 1. Check if row is in [1, rows-2] and col is in [1, cols-2]
    if (row < 1 || row > rows - 2 || col < 1 || col > cols - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // 2. Get the cell at cells[row][col]
    Cell cell = this.cell[row][col];
    // 3. If cell is not a FillableCell, return false
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
    // 4. If cell already has a pipe, return false
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // 5. Set cell.pipe = pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    // 6. Return true
    return true;
}
public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    // 1. Get the cell at cells[coord.row][coord.col]
    Cell cell = this.cell[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    // 2. If the cell is a FillableCell, set its pipe to null
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        ((FillableCell) cell).setPipe(null);
    }
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // 1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile()
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2. BFS from source cell
    // We need to track visited cells to avoid cycles
    // We'll use a queue for BFS
    
    // Get source cell position
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.getCoord();
    int sourceRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int sourceCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    
    // BFS
    java.util.Queue<int[]> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][cols];
    
    queue.add(new int[]{sourceRow, sourceCol, 0}); // row, col, current distance
    visited[sourceRow][sourceCol] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] current = queue.poll();
        int r = current[0];
        int c = current[1];
        int dist = current[2];
        
        if (dist > distance) continue;
        
        Cell currentCell = this.cell[r][c];
        
        // If this is a FillableCell with a pipe
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) currentCell;
            Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.isFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                newlyFilled++;
                // Add to filledTiles
                Coordinate coord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                coord.setRow(r);
                coord.setCol(c);
                filledTiles.add(coord);
            }
        }
        
        // If we haven't reached max distance, expand to neighbors
        if (dist < distance) {
            // For each direction, check if the current cell connects in that direction
            // and the neighbor connects in the opposite direction
            
            // Check each possible direction
            // UP
            if (r > 0 && !visited[r-1][c]) {
                Cell neighbor = this.cell[r-1][c];
                if (cellsConnected(r, c, r-1, c, Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN)) {
                    visited[r-1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r-1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // DOWN
            if (r < rows-1 && !visited[r+1][c]) {
                if (cellsConnected(r, c, r+1, c, Direction.DOWN, Direction.UP)) {
                    visited[r+1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r+1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // LEFT
            if (c > 0 && !visited[r][c-1]) {
                if (cellsConnected(r, c, r, c-1, Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT)) {
                    visited[r][c-1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c-1, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // RIGHT
            if (c < cols-1 && !visited[r][c+1]) {
                if (cellsConnected(r, c, r, c+1, Direction.RIGHT, Direction.LEFT)) {
                    visited[r][c+1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c+1, dist+1});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 6. Update prevFilledTiles
    this.prevFilledTiles = newlyFilled;
}
public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.getCoord();
    int srcRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int srcCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][cols];
    java.util.Queue<int[]> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    
    queue.add(new int[]{srcRow, srcCol, 0});
    visited[srcRow][srcCol] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] curr = queue.poll();
        int r = curr[0];
        int c = curr[1];
        int dist = curr[2];
        
        // Mark the pipe at this cell as filled (if it has a pipe)
        Cell cell = this.cell[r][c];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.isFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                newlyFilled++;
                Coordinate coord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                coord.setRow(r);
                coord.setCol(c);
                filledTiles.add(coord);
            }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) cell;
            if (!tc.isFilled()) {
                tc.setFilled(true);
                // Don't count termination cells in newlyFilled? Actually the doc says "newly filled tiles"
                // Let me check... the algorithm says "Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list"
                // and "Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round"
                // I think termination cells might not be added to filledTiles, but let me think...
                // Actually, looking at fillBeginTile - it probably marks the source as filled
                // For the sink, we might want to mark it too
            }
        }
        
        if (dist < distance) {
            // Try to expand to neighbors
            // UP
            if (r > 0 && !visited[r-1][c]) {
                if (hasConnectingPipe(r, c, r-1, c, Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN)) {
                    visited[r-1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r-1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // DOWN
            if (r < rows-1 && !visited[r+1][c]) {
                if (hasConnectingPipe(r, c, r+1, c, Direction.DOWN, Direction.UP)) {
                    visited[r+1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r+1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // LEFT
            if (c > 0 && !visited[r][c-1]) {
                if (hasConnectingPipe(r, c, r, c-1, Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT)) {
                    visited[r][c-1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c-1, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // RIGHT
            if (c < cols-1 && !visited[r][c+1]) {
                if (hasConnectingPipe(r, c, r, c+1, Direction.RIGHT, Direction.LEFT)) {
                    visited[r][c+1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c+1, dist+1});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    this.prevFilledTiles = newlyFilled;
}
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    if (row < 1 || row > rows - 2 || col < 1 || col > cols - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell cell = this.cell[row][col];
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    Cell cell = this.cell[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        ((FillableCell) cell).setPipe(null);
    }
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.getCoord();
    int srcRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int srcCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][cols];
    java.util.Queue<int[]> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    
    queue.add(new int[]{srcRow, srcCol, 0});
    visited[srcRow][srcCol] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] curr = queue.poll();
        int r = curr[0];
        int c = curr[1];
        int dist = curr[2];
        
        // Mark the current cell's pipe as filled
        Cell cell = this.cell[r][c];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.isFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                newlyFilled++;
                Coordinate coord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                coord.setRow(r);
                coord.setCol(c);
                filledTiles.add(coord);
            }
        }
        
        if (dist < distance) {
            // UP
            if (r > 0 && !visited[r-1][c]) {
                boolean currentConnectsUp = false;
                boolean neighborConnectsDown = false;
                
                Cell currCell = this.cell[r][c];
                Cell neighborCell = this.cell[r-1][c];
                
                if (currCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) currCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.UP)) {
                        currentConnectsUp = true;
                    }
                } else if (currCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) currCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.UP) {
                        currentConnectsUp = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.DOWN)) {
                        neighborConnectsDown = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.DOWN) {
                        neighborConnectsDown = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (currentConnectsUp && neighborConnectsDown) {
                    visited[r-1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r-1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            
            // DOWN
            if (r < rows - 1 && !visited[r+1][c]) {
                boolean currentConnectsDown = false;
                boolean neighborConnectsUp = false;
                
                Cell currCell = this.cell[r][c];
                Cell neighborCell = this.cell[r+1][c];
                
                if (currCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) currCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.DOWN)) {
                        currentConnectsDown = true;
                    }
                } else if (currCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) currCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.DOWN) {
                        currentConnectsDown = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.UP)) {
                        neighborConnectsUp = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.UP) {
                        neighborConnectsUp = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (currentConnectsDown && neighborConnectsUp) {
                    visited[r+1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r+1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            
            // LEFT
            if (c > 0 && !visited[r][c-1]) {
                boolean currentConnectsLeft = false;
                boolean neighborConnectsRight = false;
                
                Cell currCell = this.cell[r][c];
                Cell neighborCell = this.cell[r][c-1];
                
                if (currCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) currCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.LEFT)) {
                        currentConnectsLeft = true;
                    }
                } else if (currCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) currCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.LEFT) {
                        currentConnectsLeft = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.RIGHT)) {
                        neighborConnectsRight = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.RIGHT) {
                        neighborConnectsRight = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (currentConnectsLeft && neighborConnectsRight) {
                    visited[r][c-1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c-1, dist+1});
                }
            }
            
            // RIGHT
            if (c < cols - 1 && !visited[r][c+1]) {
                boolean currentConnectsRight = false;
                boolean neighborConnectsLeft = false;
                
                Cell currCell = this.cell[r][c];
                Cell neighborCell = this.cell[r][c+1];
                
                if (currCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) currCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.RIGHT)) {
                        currentConnectsRight = true;
                    }
                } else if (currCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) currCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.RIGHT) {
                        currentConnectsRight = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    Pipe p = ((FillableCell) neighborCell).getPipe();
                    if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(Direction.LEFT)) {
                        neighborConnectsLeft = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    if (((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getPointingTo() == Direction.LEFT) {
                        neighborConnectsLeft = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (currentConnectsRight && neighborConnectsLeft) {
                    visited[r][c+1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c+1, dist+1});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    this.prevFilledTiles = newlyFilled;
}

public boolean hasLost() {
    return prevFilledTiles == 0;
}

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe) {
    if (row < 1 || row > rows - 2 || col < 1 || col > cols - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell cell = this.cell[row][col];
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    Cell cell = this.cell[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        ((FillableCell) cell).setPipe(null);
    }
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.getCoord();
    int srcRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int srcCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][cols];
    Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    
    queue.add(new int[]{srcRow, srcCol, 0});
    visited[srcRow][srcCol] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] curr = queue.poll();
        int r = curr[0];
        int c = curr[1];
        int dist = curr[2];
        
        Cell cell = this.cell[r][c];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.isFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                newlyFilled++;
                Coordinate coord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                coord.setRow(r);
                coord.setCol(c);
                filledTiles.add(coord);
            }
        }
        
        if (dist < distance) {
            // Check UP
            if (r > 0 && !visited[r-1][c]) {
                if (hasConnectingPath(r, c, r-1, c, Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN)) {
                    visited[r-1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r-1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // Check DOWN
            if (r < rows-1 && !visited[r+1][c]) {
                if (hasConnectingPath(r, c, r+1, c, Direction.DOWN, Direction.UP)) {
                    visited[r+1][c] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r+1, c, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // Check LEFT
            if (c > 0 && !visited[r][c-1]) {
                if (hasConnectingPath(r, c, r, c-1, Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT)) {
                    visited[r][c-1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c-1, dist+1});
                }
            }
            // Check RIGHT
            if (c < cols-1 && !visited[r][c+1]) {
                if (hasConnectingPath(r, c, r, c+1, Direction.RIGHT, Direction.LEFT)) {
                    visited[r][c+1] = true;
                    queue.add(new int[]{r, c+1, dist+1});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    this.prevFilledTiles = newlyFilled;
}

// Helper method to check if two adjacent cells have matching connections
private boolean hasConnectingPath(int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2, Direction dirFrom1, Direction dirFrom2) {
    Cell cell1 = this.cell[r1][c1];
    Cell cell2 = this.cell[r2][c2];
    
    boolean cell1Connects = false;
    boolean cell2Connects = false;
    
    if (cell1 instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell) cell1).getPipe();
        if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dirFrom1)) {
            cell1Connects = true;
        }
    } else if (cell1 instanceof TerminationCell) {
        if (((TerminationCell) cell1).getPointingTo() == dirFrom1) {
            cell1Connects = true;
        }
    }
    
    if (cell2 instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell) cell2).getPipe();
        if (p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dirFrom2)) {
            cell2Connects = true;
        }
    } else if (cell2 instanceof TerminationCell) {
        if (((TerminationCell) cell2).getPointingTo() == dirFrom2) {
            cell2Connects = true;
        }
    }
    
    return cell1Connects && cell2Connects;
}

```java
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
   *   3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions (one pipe's direction must be opposite of the other)
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
   *   5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
   *   6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, prevFilledTiles field, sourceCell field, fillBeginTile(), Cell family fields
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, FillableCell, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, PipeShape
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum BFS depth to fill (positive integer)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 1
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the specified distance that are connected via matching directions are marked as filled, and filledTiles list is updated.
```

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;

                continue;

            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();

            }

                continue;
            }

            // For source cell, use pointingTo
            // For other cells, check their pipe's connections
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {

                    currentMatches = true;
                }

                        currentMatches = true;

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // 1. Check if row is in [1, rows-2] and col is in [1, cols-2]; if not, return false
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // 2. Get the cell at cells[row][col]
    Cell cell = getCell()[row][col];
    // 3. If cell is not a FillableCell, return false
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
    // 4. If cell already has a pipe (cell.pipe != null), return false
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // 5. Set cell.pipe = pipe
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    // 6. Return true
    return true;
}

    }
}
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new java.util.HashMap<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    distMap.put(sourceCoord, 0);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curDist = distMap.get(current);
        
        if (curDist >= distance) {
            continue;
        }
        
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // 3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) nextCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the neighbor's pipe has a connection pointing back (opposite direction)
            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the current cell has a matching connection pointing toward the neighbor
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {
                // Source cell uses pointingTo direction
                if (source.getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentMatches = true;
                }
            } else {
                Cell curCell = getCell()[curRow][curCol];
                if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell curFillable = (FillableCell) curCell;
                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // 4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
            if (!pipe.isFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                
                // 5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
                Coordinate tileCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
                tileCoord.setRow(nextRow);
                tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);
                getFilledTiles().add(tileCoord);
                
                newlyFilled++;
            }
            
            visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;
            
            Coordinate nextCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            nextCoord.setRow(nextRow);
            nextCoord.setCol(nextCol);
            queue.add(nextCoord);
            distMap.put(nextCoord, curDist + 1);
        }
    }
    
    // 6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
    setPrevFilledTiles(newlyFilled);
}

{
    // Return (prevFilledTiles == 0)
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == 0;
}

```java
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
   *   3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions (one pipe's direction must be opposite of the other)
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
   *   5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
   *   6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, prevFilledTiles field, sourceCell field, fillBeginTile(), Cell family fields

   * Output: void

   * Post-condition: All pipes within the specified distance that are connected via matching directions are marked as filled, and filledTiles list is updated.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) nextCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the pipe's connections include the opposite direction
            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Also check if the current cell has a matching connection
            // For source cell, use pointingTo
            // For other cells, check their pipe's connections
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {
                // Source cell
                if (source.getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentMatches = true;
                }
            } else {
                Cell curCell = getCell()[curRow][curCol];
                if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell curFillable = (FillableCell) curCell;
                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Mark as filled
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            
            // Add to filledTiles
            Coordinate tileCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            tileCoord.setRow(nextRow);
            tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);
            getFilledTiles().add(tileCoord);
            
            newlyFilled++;
            
            visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;

        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newlyFilled);
}
```

```java
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];

    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;

                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
```

```java
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();

    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;

    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {

            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {

                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }

            pipe.setFilled(true);
```

```java
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills pipes within the specified distance from the source using BFS-style expansion along connected pipes.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
   *   3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions (one pipe's direction must be opposite of the other)
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
   *   5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
   *   6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, prevFilledTiles field, sourceCell field, fillBeginTile(), Cell family fields
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, FillableCell, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, PipeShape
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum BFS depth to fill (positive integer)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 1
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the specified distance that are connected via matching directions are marked as filled, and filledTiles list is updated.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) nextCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the pipe's connections include the opposite direction
            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Also check if the current cell has a matching connection
            // For source cell, use pointingTo
            // For other cells, check their pipe's connections
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {
                // Source cell
                if (source.getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentMatches = true;
                }
            } else {
                Cell curCell = getCell()[curRow][curCol];
                if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell curFillable = (FillableCell) curCell;
                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Mark as filled
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            
            // Add to filledTiles
            Coordinate tileCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            tileCoord.setRow(nextRow);
            tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);
            getFilledTiles().add(tileCoord);
            
            newlyFilled++;
            
            visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;
            
            // Calculate BFS distance
            // We need to track distance from source
            // Let me use a different approach...
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newlyFilled);
}
```

```java
   * Summary: Fills pipes within the specified distance from the source using BFS-style expansion along connected pipes.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
   *   3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions (one pipe's direction must be opposite of the other)
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
   *   5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
   *   6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, prevFilledTiles field, sourceCell field, fillBeginTile(), Cell family fields
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, FillableCell, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, PipeShape

   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 1
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the specified distance that are connected via matching directions are marked as filled, and filledTiles list is updated.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) nextCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the pipe's connections include the opposite direction
            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Also check if the current cell has a matching connection
            // For source cell, use pointingTo
            // For other cells, check their pipe's connections
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {
                // Source cell
                if (source.getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentMatches = true;
                }
            } else {
                Cell curCell = getCell()[curRow][curCol];
                if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell curFillable = (FillableCell) curCell;
                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Mark as filled
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            
            // Add to filledTiles
            Coordinate tileCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            tileCoord.setRow(nextRow);
            tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);
            getFilledTiles().add(tileCoord);
            
            newlyFilled++;
            
            visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;

            // We need to track distance from source

        }
```

```java
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;

    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {

                    }
```

```java
   *   1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
   *   3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions (one pipe's direction must be opposite of the other)
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
   *   5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
   *   6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, prevFilledTiles field, sourceCell field, fillBeginTile(), Cell family fields
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, FillableCell, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, PipeShape
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum BFS depth to fill (positive integer)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 1
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the specified distance that are connected via matching directions are marked as filled, and filledTiles list is updated.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) nextCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the pipe's connections include the opposite direction
            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Also check if the current cell has a matching connection
            // For source cell, use pointingTo
            // For other cells, check their pipe's connections
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {
                // Source cell
                if (source.getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentMatches = true;
                }
            } else {
                Cell curCell = getCell()[curRow][curCol];
                if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell curFillable = (FillableCell) curCell;
                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Mark as filled
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            
            // Add to filledTiles
            Coordinate tileCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            tileCoord.setRow(nextRow);
            tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);
            getFilledTiles().add(tileCoord);
            
            newlyFilled++;
            
            visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;
            
            // Calculate BFS distance
            // We need to track distance from source
            // Let me use a different approach...
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newlyFilled);
}
```

```java
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;

    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }

                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
```

```java
   * Summary: Fills pipes within the specified distance from the source using BFS-style expansion along connected pipes.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first call (distance == 1), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance
   *   3. For each pipe cell encountered, check if adjacent pipes have matching connection directions (one pipe's direction must be opposite of the other)
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled (set pipe.filled = true)
   *   5. Add newly filled tile coordinates to filledTiles list
   *   6. Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round
   * Related Features: filledTiles field, prevFilledTiles field, sourceCell field, fillBeginTile(), Cell family fields
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, FillableCell, TerminationCell, Pipe, Direction, PipeShape
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum BFS depth to fill (positive integer)
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 1
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the specified distance that are connected via matching directions are marked as filled, and filledTiles list is updated.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // BFS from source cell
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) nextCell;
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if the pipe's connections include the opposite direction
            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Also check if the current cell has a matching connection
            // For source cell, use pointingTo
            // For other cells, check their pipe's connections
            boolean currentMatches = false;
            if (current.equals(sourceCoord)) {
                // Source cell
                if (source.getPointingTo() == dir) {
                    currentMatches = true;
                }
            } else {
                Cell curCell = getCell()[curRow][curCol];
                if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    FillableCell curFillable = (FillableCell) curCell;
                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Mark as filled
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            
            // Add to filledTiles
            Coordinate tileCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
            tileCoord.setRow(nextRow);
            tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);
            getFilledTiles().add(tileCoord);
            
            newlyFilled++;
            
            visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;
            
            // Calculate BFS distance
            // We need to track distance from source
            // Let me use a different approach...
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newlyFilled);
}
```

   *   2. Perform BFS from the source cell, expanding outward up to the given distance

    }

    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }

                continue;
            }

            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }

            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }

            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;

                    currentMatches = true;
                }

                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Mark as filled
            pipe.setFilled(true);

            tileCoord.setCol(nextCol);

```java
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)

    if (distance == 1) {

    }

    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Use a queue for BFS
    java.util.Queue<Coordinate> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited[sourceCoord.getRow()][sourceCoord.getCol()] = true;
    
    int newlyFilled = 0;
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int curRow = current.getRow();
        int curCol = current.getCol();
        
        // Check all 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES) {
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            int nextRow = curRow + offset.getRow();
            int nextCol = curCol + offset.getCol();
            
            // Check bounds
            if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= getRows() || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (visited[nextRow][nextCol]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell nextCell = getCell()[nextRow][nextCol];
            if (!(nextCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }

            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {

            }

            Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            if (!pipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                continue;

            // For source cell, use pointingTo

            boolean currentMatches = false;

                    Pipe curPipe = curFillable.getPipe();
                    if (curPipe != null && curPipe.getConnections().contains(dir)) {
                        currentMatches = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentMatches) {
                continue;
```
