public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction dir = source.getPointingTo();
    Coordinate offset = getOffset(dir);
    Coordinate startCoord = source.getCoord().add(offset);
    
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Map<Coordinate, Integer> depthMap = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    
    queue.add(startCoord);
    visited.add(startCoord);
    depthMap.put(startCoord, 1);
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDepth = depthMap.get(current);
        
        if (currentDepth > distance) {
            continue;
        }
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
            continue;
        }
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe == null) {
            continue;
        }
        
        if (!pipe.isFilled()) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
            newFilledCount++;
        }
        
        if (currentDepth >= distance) {
            continue;
        }
        
        for (Direction connDir : pipe.getConnections()) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(getOffset(connDir));
            
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            int nRow = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nCol = neighborCoord.getCol();
            if (nRow < 0 || nRow >= getRows() || nCol < 0 || nCol >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nRow][nCol];
            if (!(neighborCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
            if (neighborPipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Direction opposite = getOpposite(connDir);
            if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                depthMap.put(neighborCoord, currentDepth + 1);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }

        return false;

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Get source cell info
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction pointingTo = source.getPointingTo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Compute starting cell
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    switch (pointingTo.getValue()) {
        case Direction.UP_VALUE: startRow--; break;
        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: startRow++; break;
        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: startCol--; break;
        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: startCol++; break;
    }
    
    // BFS
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    // Use a simple list-based queue
    List<int[]> queue = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> depths = new ArrayList<>();
    queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol});
    depths.add(1); // depth 1 from source
    visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    
    int index = 0;
    while (index < queue.size()) {
        int[] pos = queue.get(index);
        int r = pos[0];
        int c = pos[1];
        int depth = depths.get(index);
        index++;
        
        Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
        if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) continue;
        FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
        if (pipe == null) continue;
        
        // Mark pipe as filled
        pipe.setFilled(true);
        Coordinate coord = fc.getCoord();
        getFilledTiles().add(coord);
        newFilledCount++;
        
        if (depth >= distance) continue;
        
        // Explore connections
        for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
            int nr = r, nc = c;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE: nr--; break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: nr++; break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: nc--; break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: nc++; break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) continue;
            if (visited[nr][nc]) continue;
            
            Cell neighbor = getCell()[nr][nc];
            if (!(neighbor instanceof FillableCell)) continue;
            FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighbor;
            Pipe npipe = nfc.getPipe();
            if (npipe == null) continue;
            
            // Check if neighbor's pipe has connection in opposite direction
            Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
            if (npipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited[nr][nc] = true;
                queue.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                depths.add(depth + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledCount);
}

    fillBeginTile();
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction pointingTo = source.getPointingTo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    switch (pointingTo.getValue()) {
        case Direction.UP_VALUE:
            startRow--;
            break;
        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
            startRow++;
            break;
        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
            startCol--;
            break;
        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
            startCol++;
            break;
    }
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    List<int[]> queue = new ArrayList<int[]>();
    List<Integer> depths = new ArrayList<Integer>();
    queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol});
    depths.add(Integer.valueOf(1));
    visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    int index = 0;
    
    while (index < queue.size()) {
        int[] pos = queue.get(index);
        int r = pos[0];
        int c = pos[1];
        int depth = depths.get(index).intValue();
        index++;
        
        Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
        if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
            continue;
        }
        FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
        if (pipe == null) {
            continue;
        }
        
        pipe.setFilled(true);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc.getCoord());
        newFilledCount++;
        
        if (depth >= distance) {
            continue;
        }
        
        for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
            int nr = r;
            int nc = c;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    nr--;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    nr++;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    nc--;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    nc++;
                    break;
            }
            
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= getRows() || nc < 0 || nc >= getCols()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited[nr][nc]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Cell neighbor = getCell()[nr][nc];
            if (!(neighbor instanceof FillableCell)) {
                continue;
            }
            FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighbor;
            Pipe npipe = nfc.getPipe();
            if (npipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            Direction opposite;
            switch (dir.getValue()) {
                case Direction.UP_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.DOWN;
                    break;
                case Direction.DOWN_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.UP;
                    break;
                case Direction.LEFT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.RIGHT;
                    break;
                case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE:
                    opposite = Direction.LEFT;
                    break;
                default:
                    continue;
            }
            
            if (npipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited[nr][nc] = true;
                queue.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                depths.add(Integer.valueOf(depth + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledCount);
}

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // Check if row is in [1, rows-2] and col is in [1, cols-2]
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get the cell at cells[row][col]
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    // If the cell is not a FillableCell, return false
    if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
    // If the cell already has a pipe, return false
    if (fillableCell.getPipe() != null) {
        return false;
    }
    // Set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
    fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // If distance == 1, call fillBeginTile() first
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Get source cell and its pointingTo direction
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction dir = source.getPointingTo();
    
    // Get the offset for the direction to find the starting adjacent cell
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
    
    // Get source cell's coordinate
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow() + offset.getRow();
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol() + offset.getCol();
    
    // BFS
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    java.util.Queue<int[]> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    java.util.Queue<Integer> depthQueue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    
    // Check if starting cell is within bounds
    if (startRow >= 0 && startRow < getRows() && startCol >= 0 && startCol < getCols()) {
        queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol});
        depthQueue.add(1);
        visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    }
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] pos = queue.poll();
        int curDepth = depthQueue.poll();
        int r = pos[0];
        int c = pos[1];
        
        Cell curCell = getCell()[r][c];
        
        if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillCell = (FillableCell) curCell;
            Pipe curPipe = fillCell.getPipe();
            
            if (curPipe != null) {
                // Mark the cell as filled
                if (!curPipe.isFilled()) {
                    curPipe.setFilled(true);
                    newFilledCount++;
                    getFilledTiles().add(fillCell.getCoord());
                }
                
                // If we haven't reached max distance, explore neighbors
                if (curDepth < distance) {
                    for (Direction connDir : curPipe.getConnections()) {
                        Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(connDir);
                        Coordinate neighborOffset = helper.getOffset(connDir);
                        int nr = r + neighborOffset.getRow();
                        int nc = c + neighborOffset.getCol();
                        
                        if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited[nr][nc]) {
                            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                                FillableCell neighborFill = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFill.getPipe();
                                if (neighborPipe != null && neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                                    visited[nr][nc] = true;
                                    queue.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                                    depthQueue.add(curDepth + 1);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledCount);
}

public boolean hasLost()
{
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == 0;
}

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Fills pipes within the specified distance from the source using BFS-style expansion. Water propagates along connected pipes with matching directions.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. If distance == 1, call fillBeginTile() first.
 *   2. Perform BFS starting from the source cell's adjacent cell in the source's pointingTo direction.
 *   3. For each cell reached, check its pipe's connection directions.
 *   4. For each connection direction, check if the neighbor in that direction:
 *      (a) is a FillableCell with a pipe,
 *      (b) the neighbor's pipe has a connection in the opposite direction of the current direction,
 *      (c) the BFS depth is within the given distance.
 *   5. Mark reached cells as filled.
 *   6. Update filledTiles list and prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round.
 * Related Features: filledTiles, prevFilledTiles, sourceCell, cells fields.
 * Related Classes: Coordinate, Direction, Cell, FillableCell, Pipe, TerminationCell
 * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (number of steps) water should flow from the source (positive integer).
 * Output: void
 * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
 * Post-condition: Pipes within the specified distance that are connected to the source are marked as filled. filledTiles and prevFilledTiles are updated.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If distance == 1, call fillBeginTile() first.
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // 2. Perform BFS starting from the source cell's adjacent cell in the source's pointingTo direction.
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction dir = source.getPointingTo();
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow() + offset.getRow();
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol() + offset.getCol();
    
    // BFS setup
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Queue<Integer> depthQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    
    // Check if starting cell is within bounds
    if (startRow >= 0 && startRow < getRows() && startCol >= 0 && startCol < getCols()) {
        queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol});
        depthQueue.add(1);
        visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    }
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] pos = queue.poll();
        int curDepth = depthQueue.poll();
        int r = pos[0];
        int c = pos[1];
        
        Cell curCell = getCell()[r][c];
        
        // Check if the cell is a FillableCell with a pipe
        if (curCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillCell = (FillableCell) curCell;
            Pipe curPipe = fillCell.getPipe();
            
            if (curPipe != null) {
                // 5. Mark reached cells as filled
                if (!curPipe.isFilled()) {
                    curPipe.setFilled(true);
                    newFilledCount++;
                    getFilledTiles().add(fillCell.getCoord());
                }
                
                // 3. For each cell reached, check its pipe's connection directions.
                // 4. For each connection direction, check if the neighbor in that direction...
                if (curDepth < distance) {
                    for (Direction connDir : curPipe.getConnections()) {
                        Direction oppositeDir = helper.getOpposite(connDir);
                        Coordinate neighborOffset = helper.getOffset(connDir);
                        int nr = r + neighborOffset.getRow();
                        int nc = c + neighborOffset.getCol();
                        
                        // Check bounds
                        if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited[nr][nc]) {
                            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                            // (a) is a FillableCell with a pipe
                            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                                FillableCell neighborFill = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFill.getPipe();
                                // (b) the neighbor's pipe has a connection in the opposite direction
                                if (neighborPipe != null && neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(oppositeDir)) {
                                    // (c) the BFS depth is within the given distance
                                    visited[nr][nc] = true;
                                    queue.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                                    depthQueue.add(curDepth + 1);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 6. Update filledTiles list and prevFilledTiles with the count of newly filled tiles in this round.
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledCount);
}

    // 2. Get the cell at cells[row][col]

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction pointingTo = source.getPointingTo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Get the adjacent cell in the pointingTo direction
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow() + getRowOffset(pointingTo);
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol() + getColOffset(pointingTo);
    
    // BFS
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>(); // {row, col, depth}
    
    // But wait, we need to check if the start cell is valid first
    if (startRow >= 0 && startRow < getRows() && startCol >= 0 && startCol < getCols()) {
        queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol, 1});
        visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    }
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] current = queue.poll();
        int row = current[0];
        int col = current[1];
        int depth = current[2];
        
        Cell cell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fillable.getPipe();
            
            if (pipe != null) {
                // Mark as filled
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                filledTiles.add(fillable.getCoord()); // Wait, the field is filledTiles
                // Actually it's getFilledTiles()
                newFilledCount++;
                
                if (depth < distance) {
                    // Check connections
                    for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                        int neighborRow = row + getRowOffset(dir);
                        int neighborCol = col + getColOffset(dir);
                        
                        if (neighborRow >= 0 && neighborRow < getRows() && 
                            neighborCol >= 0 && neighborCol < getCols() && 
                            !visited[neighborRow][neighborCol]) {
                            
                            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[neighborRow][neighborCol];
                            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                                FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                                if (neighborPipe != null) {
                                    Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                                    if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                        visited[neighborRow][neighborCol] = true;
                                        queue.add(new int[]{neighborRow, neighborCol, depth + 1});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledCount);
}
private Direction getOpposite(Direction dir) {
    switch (dir.getValue()) {
        case Direction.UP_VALUE: return Direction.DOWN;
        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: return Direction.UP;
        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: return Direction.RIGHT;
        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: return Direction.LEFT;
        default: return null;
    }
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    if (distance == 1) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Direction pointingTo = source.getPointingTo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    
    // Get the adjacent cell in the pointingTo direction
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow();
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol();
    switch (pointingTo.getValue()) {
        case Direction.UP_VALUE: startRow--; break;
        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: startRow++; break;
        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: startCol--; break;
        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: startCol++; break;
    }
    
    // BFS
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    
    if (startRow >= 0 && startRow < getRows() && startCol >= 0 && startCol < getCols()) {
        queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol, 1});
        visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    }
    
    int newFilledCount = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] current = queue.poll();
        int row = current[0];
        int col = current[1];
        int depth = current[2];
        
        Cell cell = getCell()[row][col];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fillable.getPipe();
            
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.isFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                getFilledTiles().add(fillable.getCoord());
                newFilledCount++;
            }
            
            if (depth < distance && pipe != null) {
                for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                    int neighborRow = row;
                    int neighborCol = col;
                    switch (dir.getValue()) {
                        case Direction.UP_VALUE: neighborRow--; break;
                        case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: neighborRow++; break;
                        case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: neighborCol--; break;
                        case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: neighborCol++; break;
                    }
                    
                    if (neighborRow >= 0 && neighborRow < getRows() && 
                        neighborCol >= 0 && neighborCol < getCols() && 
                        !visited[neighborRow][neighborCol]) {
                        
                        Cell neighborCell = getCell()[neighborRow][neighborCol];
                        if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                            FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                            Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                            if (neighborPipe != null) {
                                // Check if neighbor's pipe has a connection in the opposite direction
                                Direction opposite;
                                switch (dir.getValue()) {
                                    case Direction.UP_VALUE: opposite = Direction.DOWN; break;
                                    case Direction.DOWN_VALUE: opposite = Direction.UP; break;
                                    case Direction.LEFT_VALUE: opposite = Direction.RIGHT; break;
                                    case Direction.RIGHT_VALUE: opposite = Direction.LEFT; break;
                                    default: opposite = null;
                                }
                                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                    visited[neighborRow][neighborCol] = true;
                                    queue.add(new int[]{neighborRow, neighborCol, depth + 1});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilledCount);
}
